description.zh:
时间戳，单位：秒 。

当时间早于当前时间则立即发送，晚于当前时间为定时发送。

最晚不能超过一个月。
description.en:
The timestamp, in seconds.

If the specified time is earlier than the current time, the message is sent immediately. If the specified time is later than the current time, the message is sent at the scheduled time.

The scheduled time cannot be more than one month from the current time.

description.zh: 短信模版编号，可以在控制台查看。
description.en: The ID of the SMS template. You can view the template ID in the console.

description.zh: 动态参数短信，替换的参数，格式{1}{2}
description.en: The replacement dynamic parameter for an SMS message, in the format {1}{2}.
The list of destination MSISDNs to which the SMS message is sent.

description.zh: 自定义任务名称，不能包含特殊字符，最长40个字符。
description.en: The custom task name. The name cannot contain special characters and can be up to 40 characters in length.
